tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search below-market used-car deals with filters (brand, model, price, year, mileage, fuel, body type, country, discount). Paginated; returns each deal with its listing, market stat, deal score and % below median.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Get full detail for one deal by its deal id: listing, price history, market stats, prediction and why it is a deal.

tools.name: list_hot_deals
tools.description: Top deals right now, ranked by deal score (biggest discount vs market first).

tools.name: list_recently_reduced
tools.description: Deals whose price was recently cut (1–40% drop between the two latest prices).

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Brands that currently have active deals, with deal counts. Accepts the same filters as search_deals.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Models for a given brand that currently have active deals, with counts.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Countries/markets that currently have active deals, with counts.

tools.name: get_market_trend
tools.description: Current median/avg price, listing count and 7d-vs-30d trend for one brand+model.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: 90-day daily price history (median, avg, count) for a brand+model, optionally narrowed by fuel.

tools.name: estimate_valuation
tools.description: Estimate a fair price range (min/median/max) for a specific car from comparable listings.

tools.name: get_weekly_summary
tools.description: This week at a glance: number of new deals, the single best deal, and average savings.

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: Comprehensive market snapshot for a country: price pulse and direction, buyer/seller verdict, fuel & body-type & brand breakdowns, deal hotspots, 90d price trend, supply/freshness, oversupply and fast-mover signals.

tools.name: get_price_movers
tools.description: Segments (brand+model+fuel) whose median price moved most over ~30 days, filtered to credible moves (volume floors, 5–30% band, sample-stability guard). Each is annotated with a credibility-weighted moverScore (rewards volume and a stable sample over raw magnitude).

tools.name: check_vehicle_by_vin
tools.description: Free vehicle history check against the official Czech vehicle registry (Registr silničních vozidel) by 17-character VIN: owner count and ownership timeline (companies named with IČO, private persons anonymous), STK inspection history with results, import origin, deregistration episodes, seized-docum

tools.name: search_company_fleets
tools.description: Search Czech companies by name or IČO in the vehicle registry and get their fleet size (vehicles held now / ever). Sole traders (OSVČ) are only findable by exact IČO, never by name.

tools.name: get_company_fleet
tools.description: One Czech company's registered fleet profile by IČO: vehicles owned now and ever, vehicles OPERATED (e.g. leased fleets), median holding period, owner-type classification (dealer / leasing / company / OSVČ), the paginated fleet list incl. former holdings, and its vehicles currently for sale on the m
